articles.summary: TransUnion (NYSE: TRU) today launched TransUnion First Look Functionality for Mortgage, enabling mortgage lenders to review credit insights before purchasing scores. The innovation follows TransUnion's recent extension of 99-cent VantageScore® 4.0 mortgage pricing through 2028, with no charge when lenders pull it alongside a FICO® Score. Com...
articles.title: TransUnion Launches First Look Functionality for Mortgage to Help Lenders Cut Origination Costs
